github_to_slack._comment: Values can be Slack user IDs (e.g. 'U0A1B2C3D' — enables real @pings) OR display names (e.g. 'adam.evans' — visible but won't ping). To find a user ID: open their Slack profile > ⋮ > Copy member ID.

extra_docs_team_members: _comment: Only needed if your GitHub token lacks read:org scope and can't auto-fetch the braze-inc/docs-team member list. Add GitHub usernames here as a fallback.
ignored_reviewers: _comment: GitHub logins to exclude from non-docs approval/stale checks (e.g. bots or service accounts).
